description: This file contains implementations of tensor layout operators for PyTorch, including classes for various tensor transformations such as view, reshape, flatten, squeeze, unsqueeze, split, expand, cat, stack, and chunk. It defines how to generate input specifications and code snippets for these operations, primarily used in fuzz testing or dynamic code generation.

classes.description: Base class for tensor layout operations, providing common interface and functionality.
